nextAction: Add AC-linked regression tests for terminal input control, then implement controlled terminal input/drop behavior.

acceptance.text: Terminal-generated OSC color query responses do not leak into Codex/user input while normal typed input still reaches the PTY.
Terminal copy/paste shortcuts and toolbar actions are owned by WF UI, including Ctrl+Shift+C copying terminal selection instead of opening browser developer tools.
Dragging files onto a terminal uploads them into a session drop directory and inserts usable server-side paths into terminal input.

decisions: Keep xterm.js as the terminal renderer; make WF UI own input routing, clipboard, file drops, and read-only embedded terminal behavior.
risks: Browser drag/drop cannot expose original local absolute paths; dropped files must be uploaded to a session-local drop directory.
